uncertainty: Eight bounded Packagist searches saved 242 hits and 239 distinct package names. The broad vips and imagick queries each stopped at 100; their uninspected tails may contain more parser wrappers. A separate documented FFProbe lead was tested. 16 pinned, open-source third-party package paths passed the valid local ASCII P3 control, leaving 4 of the 20-path working goal unverified. Six paths use libvips, nine use ImageMagick through PECL Imagick or CLI wrappers, and one uses FFmpeg. These are package paths across three underlying decoder families, not independent engines. Two plausible leads remain unresolved. Two tile generators were excluded after valid P3 probes because they used PHP getimagesize and could not produce valid dimensions. PHP 8.5 core and bundled GD had no documented PNM reader; three candidate APIs returned false on the P3 control. The run proves only the P3 variant, not all ASCII PNM variants. Packagist lifetime downloads rank Composer package adoption within PHP only and include uses unrelated to PNM. PECL Imagick has no comparable Packagist metric and remains unranked.
